Priya (PM): quick MIDQ ownership + status check — one line per owner please. TL;DR: M1 shipped, M2 blocked, M3 canary perf.
Priya (PM): Milestones:
• M1 (Search relevance revamp) — owner: Lina — shipped?
• M2 (Realtime reranking infra) — owner: Jamal — blocked by infra quotas
• M3 (Streaming latency targets) — owner: Lina/Maya — canary showing regression
Lina (Eng): M1 shipped yesterday, tag v1.2.0, PR #234 merged, metrics look stable (ctr +4%). :tada:
Jamal (Eng): M2 slipped — infra quota prevented scaling in staging, raised GH issue #456 and awaiting quota bump from infra. ETA +2w if no quota change.
Sam (Platform): I can apply a temporary quota bump for staging tests, but need billing approval for sustained increase. Filed finance ticket TKT-1123. Pinged @Priya for priority.
Alex (Product): If M2 is high-impact for customers we can short-circuit with a smaller model fallback to keep product promise. I can scope a minimal fallback flow this afternoon.
Priya (PM): Thanks — action items: Jamal assign fallback task to @Alex, keep GH issue #456 updated. Lina confirm M1 closed in roadmap. For M3: Lina/Maya investigate canary perf spike.
Lina (Eng): M3 feature work is on-track, but canary shows +30ms p95 tail latency. Suspect KV cache pressure from long-context tests. Repro steps in PR #789.
Maya (SRE): Confirmed — observed latency spike correlated with long-context QA runs. Suggest increasing cache TTL and adding prefix-level caching for repeated prompts. I'll add a runbook note and open incident-lite ticket INC-2026 for tracking.
Jamal (Eng): Quick CR ping: PRs outstanding — #789 (M3 perf fix) needs review, @Lina please, and #790 (M3 metrics dashboard) needs PM signoff.
Lina (Eng): On it — will review #789 today, aim to merge before EOD.
Priya (PM): Owner summary: M1 -> Lina (closed), M2 -> Jamal + Alex (fallback created), M3 -> Lina + Maya (perf investigation). Next async checkpoint: EOD Friday. Please 1-line update by then. :calendar:
deploy-bot: deploy: canary deployed to us-west-2 for M3 at 2026-04-01T15:34:10Z — monitor dashboards.
Sam (Platform): Temporary quota bump applied for 48h for staging tests. Finance ticket TKT-1123 linked.
Alex (Product): Drafting minimal fallback flow now — will post summary + sequence of API changes and config flags by 5pm. :memo:
Priya (PM): Thanks everyone — if you can't meet the EOD Friday checkpoint, DM me. :pray: 
Lina (Eng): Quick note — if fallback added, need a short eval to confirm quality delta. Recommend A/B on 10% traffic once infra secured.
Maya (SRE): I'll prepare monitoring checklist and rollback thresholds for the A/B.
Jamal (Eng): I'll update GH issue #456 with the fallback plan and link PRs.
Alex (Product): Posted initial RFC gist: https://gist.github.com/alex/fallback-minimal (short summary inside). :eyes:
Priya (PM): good. closing loop for now — will compile this into the weekly OKR update doc.
